MediaPipe local model bundles — Google / The MediaPipe Authors
Redistribution: Apache License 2.0; full text in MediaPipe-LICENSE.txt.
All three bundles are unmodified official version-1 float16 task assets.
No runtime download, cloud inference, recognition of identity, or upload is configured.

Official Apache-2.0 model cards: BlazePose GHUM 3D, BlazeFace Short Range,
MediaPipe Face Mesh V2 and Blendshape V2. Blendshape output is disabled, but the
unmodified Face task bundle includes those weights.

https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/MediaPipe%20BlazeFace%20Model%20Card%20(Short%20Range).pdf
